calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 3
calls.output_preview:
fiscal_year | fiscal_period | fiscal_period_label | period_start_date | period_end_date
FY2026/27 | 3 | FY2026/27 P03 | 2026-06-29 | 2026-08-02
(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT SUM(fsl.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'

SELECT ds.store_id, ds.store_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dp.sku) as interior_paint_skus, SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 108
  AND dp.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-06-29'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-08-02'
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name
calls.output_preview:
store_id | store_name | interior_paint_skus | total_units
